items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the fine notice
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.
items.computation: A page-2 copy of the Zustellungsurkunde shows actual formal delivery ('zugestellt am') on 17.09.2026 (Thursday), so the real delivery date is known and used instead of the statutory delivery fiction. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period starts 18.09.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period in weeks ends with the day of the last week bearing the same name as the day it began; two weeks from 18.09.2026 (Fri) lands on 01.10.2026 (Thursday, per the rules engine's counting for objection periods under § 43 StPO/§ 46 OWiG). 01.10.2026 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in Bayern, so it stays as the last day to file the objection.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: The decision becomes final (Rechtskraft) once the two-week objection period expires unused, i.e. at the end of 01.10.2026 (the computed Einspruch deadline), assuming no objection is filed. Treating 01.10.2026 as the triggering event, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes that day from the count, so the new two-week period starts 02.10.2026 and, applying § 188 Abs. 1/2 BGB, ends on 15.10.2026 (Thursday). That day is a business day in Bayern (3 October, the nationwide holiday, falls earlier and does not affect this end date), so the payment is due by 15.10.2026. If an Einspruch is filed instead, this payment deadline does not apply and the case proceeds differently.

warnings: The payment deadline of two weeks 'nach Rechtskraft' is only reached if no Einspruch is filed by 01.10.2026; filing an objection suspends this payment obligation, so treat the 15.10.2026 date as conditional (confidence lowered to medium for that reason).

Always double-check the payee IBAN (DE52 7115 0000 0000 0077 07, Sparkasse Musterau) against the letterhead before paying; it is a validly formatted German IBAN but ownership cannot be confirmed from the IBAN alone.
